content: git worktree: 'add' refuses a branch already checked out in another worktree unless --force. -b refuses an existing branch, -B force-resets it. Deleting a worktree dir without 'git worktree remove' leaves stale admin files under $GIT_DIR/worktrees until 'git worktree prune' or gc.worktreePruneExpire. 'git worktree list --porcelain' emits worktree/HEAD/branch/detached/locked/prunable fields for machine parsing. 'worktree remove' refuses dirty or submodule-containing worktrees without -f; -ff for locked. Main worktree can never be removed. Submodule support in linked worktrees is explicitly incomplete and NOT recommended. 'worktree lock' prevents pruning/moving/deleting.
